verdict.rationale: Reader offers a hosted proxy pool via `x-proxy: auto` that rotates residential and datacenter IPs, but the documented value is only `auto`, with no option to pick a country. The `X-Locale` header steers locale-specific markup through browser locale, not IP geolocation, so it only partly covers geolocation-appropriate content. Missing for 10: country-specific proxy selection parameter, documentation of supported countries/regions, hands-on corroboration of geo-targeted fetching.
